setup.title: Three minutes from sign-in to first signed consent.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.caption: Use DigiLocker or email. Two-factor optional but encouraged. We never store your password — auth happens via a one-way verifiable token.

steps.title: Pick your purposes
steps.caption: Each grant is timestamped, signed (RS256), and downloadable as evidence. The audit trail records who consented, when, and from which device.

steps.title: Change your mind anytime
steps.caption: Withdrawals propagate to every connected system in under 60 seconds. The bank receives the new instruction immediately — no human in the loop.

arch.body: Every architectural decision is documented. Every dependency is auditable. Every cryptographic choice is explained. KSCB owns the stack — top to bottom.

doors.eyebrow: Two sides of the same system
doors.title: One platform. Two front doors.
doors.sub: Citizens get one portal. Compliance teams get another. Both share the same audit chain and the same data spine.
doors.citizenCaption: A clean mobile portal where every consent is a toggle and every right is a button. Available in Malayalam, English, and Hindi — read or listen.
doors.dpoCaption: One cockpit for the DPO and her team — every privacy obligation under the DPDP Act is a screen here, with the data already wired up.
doors.inventoryTitle: Every screen behind the two doors.
doors.inventorySub: Tap any row to expand the full list of screens for that portal.
